title: Review of c51's Toner-Tu eating-flocks negative on fresh seed 41 with the v0=0 twin and a real dt/2: motile eaters become box-spanning bands (5 components, 0 persistent splits) while the still twin makes 166 dividing spots (62 persistent splits)
summary: Labkit re-runs of the finding's world.py on seed 41, 128^2, 150 frames x 80 steps (t=3000): defaults (v0 0.25), the v0=0 twin, and the world's own dt halved (WORLD_P dt 0.125, 160 steps per frame, so the same t=3000; labkit's FACTS labels the time as 6000 because it reads META dt). Motile: crescents at t~120 grow into fronts and align into travelling bands by t~1000; 5 components at the end, 8 splits, 0 persistent splits, 445 nucleations. Twin: 166 still spots, 62 persistent splits, generation 3. dt/2: 5 components, 11 splits, 0 persistent splits.

observations.M: rerun/seed41/sheet.png: crescents (t=120) become box-spanning travelling bands (t>=1000), 5 components, 0 persistent splits; twin_v0/FACTS.md: 166 spots, 62 persistent splits; dthalf/FACTS.md: 5 components, 0 persistent splits

seeds_run.result: pass (negative replicates, also at world dt/2)

controls_run.M: twin_v0 (v0 0, same seed) and dthalf (world dt 0.125)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed at the default setting only.
